articles.title: No Steering Wheel? No Problem! Zoox's Robot Taxis Can Now Charge You for a Ride
articles.summary: Imagine hopping into a car with no steering wheel or pedals—and it drives you all by itself! Zoox just got the green light to charge people for rides in its futuristic robotaxis. First stop: Las Vegas!

articles.title: Tiny Bird Carvings from 40,000 Years Ago Found in a German Cave—and They're Smaller Than Your Thumb!
articles.summary: Archaeologists in Germany just found two bird figurines carved from mammoth ivory. They're 40,000 years old and as small as a thumbnail! One bird looks like it's sitting on eggs, the other is spreading its wings to fly.

articles.title: The Secret Superpower of Molybdenum: How a Metal Helps Plants Grow
articles.summary: Scientists at MIT cracked a mystery: why some tiny helpers in soil are better at turning air into plant food. The answer? A metal called molybdenum makes iron atoms grab nitrogen extra tight!
